Rivet: eighteen paths through relic armour

One Steel base. Use one core at level 12 or above to select its permanent middle form, then evolve by level into its final form. Every form has Warbond: when it participates, all eligible battle participants earn double EXP—including partners participating through binoculars. Multiple bearers keep the bonus at ×2.

Find rare wild Rivet in Ember Quarry, Relic Crags and Sunken Fortress floor 1. A new northern branch off Dorelem Scrub’s second stretch leads to Briarbell Wood. Join Rivet against a level-34 Harpbriar and Okabriar in an optional double battle. Defeat both, or befriend either one, to rescue Rivet. Separately, recover fragments across three woodland screens, defeat the Lv. 34/36/40 guardians and solve the lantern gate. Restore the bell with Thomas de Ferrers; choose one of eighteen evolution cores as your reward. After the free choice, Thomas sells further cores for 10,000 doubloons each. Use them from Bag → Evolution. Cancel evolution to retain both Rivet and the core.

Review four new aquatic concepts and the proposed Bug / Steel Rivet branch

Growth values are percentages per level: successful HP increments give +10 HP, other stats +1. The existing bounded bonus-roll rules apply. Evolution preserves earned stats and the HP fraction, and changes future growth to the new form’s spread.

EXP falls sharply with level gap. Equal or stronger opponents retain existing rewards; foes seven to nine levels below give 1 EXP at low/mid player levels, and foes ten or more levels below give zero. Warbond doubles the ordinary reward; zero remains zero.
